annotations.title: Create, import or change a brand kit

description: Creates a brand kit, or changes one when brand_kit_id is given (only the fields sent change). With website and no brand_kit_id, the brand’s name, colours, fonts and logo are read from the site first; show the person what was found, including the font sample (fontSampleUrl), and save fonts_confirmed true once they say it matches. Brand kits put text in the brand’s fonts (shown to the image model as a typeface sample image) and designed elements in its colours. Free; the number of kits depends on the plan (1 without a plan, Creator 3, Pro 10, Business 50). Returns the saved kit (and, after an import, what was found). Example: {"website": "https://example.com"}

body_font.description: Google Fonts family for small text, e.g. "Inter"

brand_kit_id.description: The kit to change; leave out to create a new one

font_sample_base64.description: A picture of a paragraph set in the brand’s font, for fonts not on Google Fonts

fonts_confirmed.description: The person checked the fonts and their sample: they match

is_default.description: Use this kit for new image sets by default

logo_base64.description: The logo (PNG with transparency, JPG, WebP or SVG)

palette.description: Hex colours, main colour first, e.g. ["#1A1A1A", "#E8DCC8"]; [] removes them

use_logo.description: Put the logo, small, on images with a spot for it (poster, grid)

voice.description: How the brand sounds, e.g. "warm, playful, no jargon"

website.description: The brand’s website; on a new kit its brand is read from it

name: save_brand_kit
